name: OWASP Top 10
description: The reference list of the most critical web application security risks.
why: The baseline vocabulary for any security review an agent performs.

name: OWASP ASVS
description: Application Security Verification Standard: testable requirements by level.
why: Turns 'is it secure?' into a checklist with verifiable criteria.

name: Gitleaks
description: Detects hardcoded secrets in git history and working trees.
why: The cheapest high-value security check to run before every push.

name: TruffleHog
description: Secret detection with credential verification across git, files, and cloud storage.
why: Verification reduces false positives compared with regex-only scanners.

name: OSV-Scanner
description: Vulnerability scanner backed by the OSV database across lockfiles and containers.
why: A vendor-neutral way to check dependencies for known CVEs.

name: Snyk
description: Developer security platform for dependencies, containers, code, and IaC.
why: Useful when a team wants continuous scanning and remediation guidance.

name: Dependabot
description: Automated dependency updates and security alerts on GitHub.
why: Keeps the dependency surface current without manual version chasing.

name: NVD
description: National Vulnerability Database with CVE details and severity scores.
why: Primary source when you need to verify a CVE claim.

name: MITRE ATT&CK
description: Knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques.
why: Useful for threat modeling beyond a generic OWASP checklist.

name: HackerOne
description: Bug bounty and vulnerability disclosure platform.
why: Where many public programs and disclosed reports live.

name: Bugcrowd
description: Crowdsourced security testing and bug bounty platform.
why: A second major source of programs and disclosed findings.

name: PayloadsAllTheThings
description: Curated payloads and bypass techniques for web security testing.
why: A practical reference during authorized testing, not a substitute for methodology.

name: SecLists
description: Security testing wordlists for discovery, fuzzing, and credentials.
why: The standard wordlist collection for authorized recon and fuzzing.

name: ffuf
description: Fast web fuzzer for content discovery and parameter testing.
why: A core tool for authorized recon and endpoint discovery.

name: Burp Suite Community
description: Community edition of the widely used web security testing proxy.
why: Manual request interception is still essential for authorization testing.

name: Caido
description: Modern web security auditing toolkit with a lightweight proxy.
why: A faster, more modern alternative to legacy interception tools.

name: mitmproxy
description: Interactive HTTPS proxy with a Python API.
why: Scriptable traffic inspection for protocol analysis and automation.
